title: Player Info Command
description: This is a simple Fabric mod that adds a command (/playerinformation). Once run, it displays info about you (like HP, Armor, e.t.c), in chat.
body:
**⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️**

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

<hr>

**Mod Description**

**Player Info Command**, is a client-sided only Minecraft mod for the **Fabric Loader**, that adds in a command that allows you to see your player's information in chat (HP, Armor, Experience level, etc). To use this mod, run **/playerinformation**. Also, upon execution of the command, a "ding" sound will play (_minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup_).

**Information Displayed**:
1. Player's UUID
2. Health
3. Max Health
4. Absorption HP
5. Armor
6. Hunger Level
7. Saturation Level
8. Air Level (in ticks)
9. Max Air Level (Also in ticks)
10. Position (X, Y, & Z)

For a visual of this mod, please view the **[Gallery Tab](https://modrinth.com/mod/player-info-command/gallery)**.

<hr>

**Why Download?**

Accessing a bunch of your player data with a single command, is a nice thing to have in Minecraft, **increasing the overall Q.O.L (Quality of Life) of the game**.
